setup.zh: 雨下了三天。泾水清了，渭水浊了，两条河又分得出来了。雍城的井满了，卖玉的人收了摊，去井边打水。
setup.en: It rains for three days. The Jing runs clear and the Wei muddy — the two rivers can be told apart again. The wells of Yongcheng are full; the jade-seller packs up his stall and goes to draw water.

recap.zh: 雨下了三天，泾清渭浊，雍城的井满了。第九鼎的气息在东边，天下的中间。
recap.en: It rained for three days; the Jing ran clear and the Wei muddy, and Yongcheng's wells filled. The ninth cauldron's breath lay east, at the centre of the world.

text.zh: 第九鼎的气息在东边——出函谷关，到洛水，天下的中间。九鼎当年，就立在那里。
text.en: The ninth cauldron's breath lies east — out through the Hangu Pass to the Luo, the centre of the world. The nine cauldrons once stood there.

exits.means: rests, ends the chapter, asks what comes next

text.zh: 今日到此为止。豫州的路，开的时候我会告诉你。
text.en: That is all for today. When the road to Yu opens, I will tell you.
